review.text: Western Oregon's win was Seattle Pacific's first defeat since the opening night of conference play, at Northwest Nazarene. It also drew the two level as the conference's highest scorers: Western Oregon's 37 goals in all matches are more than any programme bar Seattle Pacific has scored.
